bias.zh: 反弹 · 站上 5 日均线，测试 $407–415

read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 2.3% on Nov 11 to $406.19, trading $401.71–414.98. It is above the 5-day ($389.9) and below the 10-day ($416.8), 30-day ($429.0), 100-day ($441.9) and 200-day ($426.8), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($443.17), and RSI is 43.6.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月11日上涨 2.3%，收于 $406.19，盘中区间 $401.71–414.98。股价位于 5 日均线（$389.9）上方，10 日（$416.8）、30 日（$429.0）、100 日（$441.9）和 200 日均线（$426.8）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$443.17），RSI 为 43.6。

read.en: The close cleared the 5-day and the $397.53 Nov 10 high, now support; the $414.98 high stalled in the $406.9–415 band (Sep 17 and Oct 15 lows, Nov 5 high), and the close sits just under it. Resistance is $406.9–415, then $416.8–429.0 (10, 200 and 30-day) and $443.2 (SAR). Support is $397.5–401.7, then $389.9–394.1 (5-day, Nov 6 and Nov 9 highs) and $383.1–388.4. A close above $415 would target $417–429; below $397.5, $390–394.

r.en: Sep 17 low $406.92; Nov 5 high $412.63; Oct 15 low $412.65; Nov 11 high $414.98
